desc: Handle p=2 separately: replace zeros with 1, compute B^2 mod 2, output N mod 2 everywhere.
For p>2: count zeros K, build M = A with zeros set to 0.
Implement fast matrix exponentiation modulo p to compute M^p (binary exponentiation, ikj pure-Python fallback and int64 15-bit-split numpy path).
Initialize correction matrix C: for each zero (i,i) add row i and column i of M to C; for p==3 and zero (i,j), i!=j, add M[j][i] to C[i][j].
Compute final answer as (-1)^K * (M^p + C) mod p and output rows.
Verify against samples 1-3 and brute-force p=3/p=5 cases.
